name: Loud Rattlesnake 53
author: JayRamoliya
description: Neon sky-blue text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, border-color becomes #007bff, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 0.2rem #007bff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Loud Rattlesnake 53</title>
<style>
/* Loud Rattlesnake 53 by JayRamoliya — https://uiverse.io/JayRamoliya/loud-rattlesnake-53 */
.input-style {
  padding: 10px;
  border: 2px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #555;
  outline: none;
}

.input-style:focus {
  border-color: #007bff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Enter text here" class="input-style" type="text">

</body>
</html>
